purpose: The few facts the Lab OS dashboard needs that are not machine-readable elsewhere in the repository: the status of each MASTER_CONTEXT section 37 step, the compute we have, and the key documents. Everything else in the dashboard is derived automatically from repository files by scripts/export_lab_state.py. Every entry here is cross-checked by tests/test_lab_state.py: step titles must equal MASTER_CONTEXT section 37, cited experiments/decisions must exist, a 'complete' step may only cite complete experiments and accepted decisions, and cited files must exist.

current_work.title: EXP-040 done: baseline learning rate 1e-3 measured; RoPE/GQA-2 not tested (float64 check failed its 1e-8 tolerance). Follow-up EXP-041 proposed; needs "approve EXP-041"
current_work.note: EXP-040 (Kaggle T4, 178 min, 6 of 12 runs): baseline (D-043, 32 M parameters, 100 M tokens per run) best at lr 1e-3 in both seeds (13-language mean 0.9213 / 0.9388 bits per byte); seed gaps 0.0064 and 0.0175; no failed runs. The float64 CPU = GPU check for RoPE + GQA-2 failed (1.739e-07 > 1e-8 at step 50), so its 6 runs were skipped and the baseline stays. Steps 1-27 agreed to <= 1.8e-15, then the gap grew ~1.5x per step: looks like amplified rounding, unproven. EXP-041 (proposed, end of EXPERIMENTS.md): a non-compounding one-step float64 check for both architectures (baseline = control), then, only if RoPE + GQA-2 passes, its 6 missing runs + 1 baseline control, EXP-040 rules unchanged; cap 5 GPU-h, no new upload. No code before "approve EXP-041".
